label: 214.Indian_Peacock
summary: The Indian Peacock (Pavo peacock) is an avian species characterized by specialized plumage and foraging adaptations. It primarily inhabits forest edges, cultivated farmland, and riparian scrub, where its diet consists primarily of grains, insects, worms, flower petals, and small snakes.
habitat: Forest edges, cultivated farmland, and riparian scrub
diet: Grains, insects, worms, flower petals, and small snakes
